label_rederivation_agreement.note: labels re-derived independently from the Dryad file

past_tb_field.caveat: unlike dm, which carries a 99 'Don't Know or Refused' code, past_tb has only 0/1. Whether unknown histories were coded 0 or whether history was obtained for everyone is NOT stated in the README. Self-reported; not record-verified. UNVERIFIED either way.

subgroups.exclusions: none - all 2,708 participants are classified; the two subgroups partition the negatives and share every positive

bootstrap.design: stratified; positives resampled once per replicate and shared by both subgroup AUROCs; each negative stratum resampled independently

difference_in_differences_ours_minus_lun.interpretation: positive means OUR degradation across the subgroups is larger than the commercial comparator's

negative_stratum_separability.statistic: AUROC distinguishing past-TB negatives from other negatives using our score, among negatives only - no shared-sample issue

prespecification.note: the previous-TB subgroup was identified during exploratory inspection of the Vietnam cohort in run realworld_generalization_20261021_1015 (Phase 1 diagnostic). It was NOT prespecified. All inference here is therefore exploratory and the intervals are not corrected for the selection of this subgroup out of several clinical variables examined (past_tb, dm, symptom count, contact, age band).

independent_refit_replicate.what_it_is: arm H of the Phase 2 experiment - the same configuration (regional 12x12 max, lungs-only, healthy-only negatives, seeds 17/29/43/61/79) refitted from scratch in a later run
independent_refit_replicate.interpretation: head training is not bit-reproducible. Absolute scores differ by 0.85 logits on average, yet rank correlation is 0.998 and every AUROC agrees to about 0.001. Rankings reproduce; the absolute score scale does not. Any per-source OFFSET fitted against one fitted head therefore does not transfer to another refit of the same configuration.
